items.summary: 将Prolong针对中风开发的药物用于ME/CFS患者，探索增加供氧和血流的疗效。
items.original_title: And just like that, we have our first clinical trial and pharma partnership in the works! We’re teaming up with Prolong
items.original_summary:
And just like that, we have our first clinical trial and pharma partnership in the works! We’re teaming up with Prolong to take the drug they developed for stroke and see if it can help our patients with ME/CFS by increasing oxygen delivery and blood flow. Thanks - X
